title: Claude Decision Event Schema
description: Schema for capturing Claude decisions during DART/Courseforge/Trainforge operations. Phase 0 Hardening adds event_id, seq, task_id, is_default, and outputs fields.

seq.description: Phase 0: Monotonically increasing sequence number within run

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this processing session (format: {TOOL}_{COURSE}_{YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS} or RUN_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSS_<uuid>)

course_id.description: Normalized course code. Admits both legacy underscore form (e.g., MTH_101) and post-Wave-93 hyphenated multi-segment slugs (e.g., DEMO-ALG-201-2).

artifact_id.description: SHA256 hash (first 12 chars) of produced content

task_id.description: Phase 0: Orchestrator task ID for cross-linking decisions to tasks

operation.description: Explicit action label (e.g., generate_module_html, select_sources, convert_pdf)

phase.description: Processing phase within the tool pipeline

decision_type.description: Category of decision from decision taxonomy (alphabetised; Wave 22 adds: assessment_generation, assessment_planning, boilerplate_strip, content_selection, pipeline_run_attribution, question_type_selection; Phase 3 two-pass router adds: block_escalation, block_outline_call, block_rewrite_call, block_validation_action; Phase 4 statistical tier adds: bert_ensemble_disagreement, bert_ensemble_dispersion_high, bert_ensemble_member_loaded, statistical_validation_fail, statistical_validation_pass; Wave W-D14 course-outliner in-process provider adds: course_outline_call — emitted by Courseforge.generators._outliner_provider.OutlinerProvider per synthesize_objectives() invocation; rationale interpolates provider, model, course_name, chapter_count_input, weeks_input, terminal_count_emit, chapter_count_emit, output_chars, retry_count, success, optional last_error; Wave W-D15 assessment-generator in-process provider adds: assessment_generator_call — emitted by Trainforge.generators._assessment_provider.AssessmentGeneratorProvider per generate_assessments() invocation; rationale interpolates provider, model, course_code, chunk_count, target_count, emitted_questions, distinct_question_types, refusal_count, evidence_quote_emit_rate, output_chars, retry_count, success, optional last_error; three-stage textbook synthesis adds: textbook_outline_call — emitted by Courseforge.generators._textbook_synthesis_provider.TextbookSynthesisProvider per Stage-1 outline call (one, or one per chaptered split); rationale interpolates course_name, provider, model, chapter_count_input, call_mode, theme_count_emit, draft_to_count_emit, output_chars, retry_count, success; textbook_concept_call — emitted by the same provider per Stage-3 per-chapter domain-concept call; rationale interpolates course_name, provider, model, chapter_id, chapter_text_chars, concept_count_emit, chapter_text_truncated, retry_count, success; chapter_objective_call — emitted by the same provider per Stage-2 per-chapter CO-NN synthesis call; rationale interpolates course_name, provider, model, chapter_id, chapter_text_chars, co_count_emit, sub_objective_count_emit, retry_count, success; terminal_objective_reconciliation — emitted by the same provider per reconciliation call that adjusts Stage-1 draft TO-NN against Stage-2 chapter CO-NN; rationale interpolates course_name, provider, model, draft_to_count_input, co_count_input, reconciled_to_count_emit, retry_count, success; WS1 bottom-up TO derivation adds: terminal_objective_authoring — emitted by the same provider per author_terminal_for_cluster() call that authors ONE TO summarising one clustered CO group (the reconcile is replaced by bottom-up clustering when the embed client is available); rationale interpolates course_name, provider, model, cluster_index, co_count_input, output_chars, retry_count, success, optional last_error; orchestrator task-lifecycle adds: task_execution, task_completion, task_retry, workflow_execution — emitted by MCP.core.executor.TaskExecutor on every task/workflow dispatch (long-standing emit sites at executor.py task_execution/task_completion/_execute_with_retries/run_workflow); they were always written to JSONL but absent from this enum, so DECISION_VALIDATION_STRICT=true fail-closed wrongly on the orchestrator's own lifecycle captures; CB5a example-completeness safety-net gate adds one enum member: example_completeness_check — emitted by lib.validators.example_completeness.ExampleCompletenessValidator once per audited example block at post_rewrite_validation; rationale interpolates block_id, block_type, word_count, has_solution_evidence, p_count, and min_word_tokens so a replay can tell whether an example block carried a real worked solution or only a stub problem statement. Warning-severity day-1 (SHADOW); the regenerate/critical flip is calibration-gated and DEFERRED. a6d6291b numeric-equivalence gate adds one enum member: assessment_numeric_equivalence_check — emitted by lib.validators.assessment_numeric_equivalence.AssessmentNumericEquivalenceValidator once per audited numeric assessment_item block at inter_tier_validation + post_rewrite_validation; rationale interpolates block_id, n_options, n_numeric_parsed, equivalent_found so a replay can tell whether a distractor parsed to the same fractions.Fraction value as the correct answer (the 4/6 == 2/3 blind spot token-Jaccard distinctness can't catch). Scope-limited to numeric/fraction MCQs (non-numeric text options skip-pass). Warning-severity day-1; the critical flip is calibration-gated and DEFERRED. Finding-17 concept/sub-objective layer adds one enum member: sub_objective_derivation — emitted by lib.objectives.sub_objectives.derive_sub_objectives_for_co once per chapter objective at course_planning; rationale interpolates co_id, chunk_count (grounded source chunks in), sub_count (sub-objectives out), path (deterministic|llm|none), embedder_available, provider, model so a replay can tell whether a CO's concept layer was clustered deterministically or authored by the optional bounded LLM arm. Anti-fabrication: a derived sub-objective's source_chunk_ids is always a strict subset of the CO's cited chunk set. W10 assessment-surface synthesis adds two enum members for the PRODUCT (learner-facing, NOT training-data) assessment prose seat emitted by MCP.tools.pipeline_tools._run_assessment_synthesis (assessment_synthesis phase, pre-packaging): assignment_prompt_synthesis -- emitted once per LLM call authoring a short prose assignment task grounded in a CO-cluster; rationale interpolates objective_id, source_chunk_ids, provider, model, n_grounded_chunks so a replay can attribute the assignment prose to its grounding + backend; and discussion_prompt_synthesis -- emitted once per LLM call authoring a discussion prompt grounded in a TERMINAL objective; rationale interpolates the same objective_id / source_chunk_ids / provider / model / n_grounded_chunks signal set. Both carry an objective_id from the real synthesized-objectives universe so the assessment_objective_alignment grounding gate fires unchanged; the objective quiz-item generation reuses the existing assessment_planning / assessment_generation / question_generation enum members)

rationale.description: Why this decision was made (critical for training - minimum 20 chars). Per-decision_type signal contracts: ``pair_claim_support_check`` rationale interpolates ``chunk_id``, ``pair_kind``, ``total_claims``, ``entailed_count``, ``unsupported_count``, ``contradicted_count``, ``claim_support_rate``, ``claim_contradicted_rate``, ``nli_loaded``, ``deps_missing``, ``promotion_status``, ``rejection_reason``, AND (Wave 5 W5.D) ``structured_attribution_used: bool`` + ``per_claim_match_count: int`` so an audit can replay whether the per-claim attribution scoping path fired or the validator fell back to whole-chunk-text scoring. W-D11 T11.2 (commit 5b9445e) extends the same rationale with ``evidence_quote_coverage_rate``, ``evidence_quote_substring_fail_rate``, and ``evidence_quote_char_span_mismatch_rate`` (interpolated as ``evidence_quote: coverage={pct:.2%}, substring_fail={pct:.2%}, char_span_mismatch={pct:.2%}``) so a replay can tell whether the cited evidence_quote actually matched the chunk text + char_span without re-running NLI. ``claim_support_check`` (block-side mirror) carries the analogous shape — rationale interpolates ``block_id``, ``total_claims``, ``entailed_count``, ``unsupported_count``, ``contradicted_count``, ``claim_support_rate``, ``claim_contradicted_rate``, ``nli_loaded``, ``deps_missing``, AND (W-D11 T11.1, commit 58650de) the same three ``evidence_quote_*`` rates with identical formatting. No new enum members; documentation-only signal-contract refresh. W4 NLI grounding gate adds two enum members: ``block_prose_entailment_check`` — emitted by lib.validators.block_prose_entailment.BlockProseEntailmentValidator once per SCORED rewrite-tier block; rationale interpolates ``block_type``, ``scored_count``, ``entailed_count``, ``unsupported_count``, ``contradicted_count``, ``computational_count``, ``filtered_count``, ``windowed_count``, ``block_entailment_rate``, ``min_rate``, ``entailment_floor``, ``nli_revision``, ``nli_device``, ``shadow`` (bool — whether the gate ran shadow/compute-only), and ``failure_codes`` so a replay can tell whether on-topic prose was entailed by its cited chunk vs fabricated; ``objective_entailment_check`` — emitted by lib.validators.objective_entailment.ObjectiveEntailmentValidator once per audited LO at course_planning; rationale interpolates ``lo_id`` (in the leading text), ``hierarchy`` level, ``attribution_shape``, ``cited_chunk_count``, ``scored_count``, ``entailed`` (bool), ``contradicted`` (bool), ``windowed`` (bool), ``groundedness_rate``, ``entailment_floor``, ``nli_revision``, ``nli_device``, ``shadow``, and ``verdict_code`` so a replay can tell whether a synthesized objective statement was entailed by its cited chunk(s). Both gates ship SHADOW (warning + config.shadow:true) day-1; the critical flip is calibration-gated and DEFERRED. WS3 CO<->TO semantic-alignment gate adds one enum member: ``co_terminal_alignment_check`` — emitted by lib.validators.co_terminal_alignment.CoTerminalAlignmentValidator once per audited chapter objective at course_planning; rationale interpolates ``co_id`` (in the leading text), ``assigned_terminal``, ``co_to_cosine``, ``threshold``, ``above_threshold`` (bool), ``weak`` (bool), ``used_ws2_flag`` (whether the optional WS2 stamped terminal_link_score fast-path fired vs a recompute), ``embedder_strict_mode`` (so EMBEDDING_DEPS_MISSING graceful-degrade events are distinguishable from real low-cosine events), and ``failure_code`` so a replay can tell whether a CO genuinely rolls up to its force-assigned terminal. Warning-severity day-1 (detection only; WS1 is the cure); the critical flip is calibration-gated and DEFERRED. WS6a source->objective coverage-audit gate adds one enum member: ``source_coverage_check`` — emitted by lib.validators.source_coverage.SourceCoverageValidator once per audited content-bearing textbook section at course_planning; rationale interpolates ``section_heading`` (in the leading text), ``max_cosine_to_objective`` (section->nearest synthesized objective), ``coverage_floor``, ``covered`` (bool), ``embedder_strict_mode`` (so EMBEDDING_DEPS_MISSING graceful-degrade events are distinguishable from real low-cosine events), and ``failure_code`` so a replay can tell whether a textbook section's content is covered by >=1 CO/TO. Warning-severity day-1 (measurement guardrail; on the real corpus 135/135 content sections covered at floor 0.45); the critical flip is calibration-gated and DEFERRED. The numeric-literal grounding gate (math-fabrication control the number-blind NLI gate cannot provide) adds one enum member: ``numeric_literal_grounding_check`` -- emitted by lib.validators.numeric_literal_grounding.NumericLiteralGroundingValidator once per SCORED rewrite-tier block that carries fraction literals; rationale interpolates ``block_type``, ``fractions_found`` (the extracted num/denom pairs), ``source_absent_fractions`` (the flagged set), ``absent_count``, ``fraction_count``, ``source_absent_ratio`` (the calibration signal that lets the deferred critical flip move to a ratio floor), ``min_absent_fractions`` (the active threshold), and ``shadow`` so a replay can tell whether a fabricated worked-example input (e.g. -40/88, absent from the cited source) was caught where block_prose_entailment is number-blind. Warning-severity day-1; the critical flip is calibration-gated (>=2-corpus FP-rate measurement) and DEFERRED.

alternatives_considered.description: Other options that were considered and why they were not chosen

confidence.description: Confidence level in this decision (0.0 to 1.0)

is_default.description: Phase 0: True if this captures a non-decision (default value used)

udl_principles.description: Universal Design for Learning principles applied

size_bytes.description: Phase 0: Size of content in bytes

artifact_type.description: Type of artifact (html, imscc, assessment, chunk, etc.)

path.description: File path relative to run artifacts
